views.text: In April 2023, Equity Mates named Evolution Mining as one of the biggest Australian gold producers, alongside Newcrest Mining and Northern Star Resources, when outlining ways to get exposure to gold.

In March 2022, Equity Mates noted Evolution Mining appeared among the top holdings of an equal‑weighted Australian equity ETF after a quarterly rebalance, reflecting its inclusion with major ASX miners and energy names.
